title: Run manifest (v1)
description: One per run. Records what was attempted, what each source returned, why any cell produced nothing, every cross-topic decision, and whether the run is eligible for publication. A zero-result is data; an error is data; the two are never conflated.

base_run_id.description: S9-6. The run this one was DERIVED from, recorded so lineage survives in the artifact rather than only in the command that produced it. Required for mode 'linkcheck', which re-checks an existing run's targets; optional and normally absent otherwise, so every pre-S9-6 manifest stays valid untouched. That it differs from harvest_run_id and names an existing run directory is a semantic check, not a schema one.

python_unverified.description: true when --allow-python-drift was used, i.e. the interpreter is outside the tested 3.13.x range.

config.description: Which config versions this run used, so an artifact can always be traced to the rules that produced it.

source_preflight.description: Bounded re-check of every configured source at the start of a live run. Planning-time availability is never assumed.

candidates.description: What the cell PROCESSED, after both smoke caps. Not a discovery count: compare unique_candidate_keys, which is measured before either cap. The difference is not attributable to one cap.

promoted.description: false when the worker died before promotion; merge ignores unpromoted cells.

candidate_observations.description: S9-5C2 denominator. Distinct source items with a canonicalizable target that this cell ingested, measured BEFORE both processing caps. Identity is (source_id, position, target_url), a property of the item: repeated delivery of one source snapshot to several lanes is merged into provenance first and does NOT inflate this. A sighting count, not a feed-row count.

unique_candidate_keys.description: S9-5C2. Distinct canonical candidate GROUPING KEYS among those observations, before both caps. This is not the post-cap `candidates` field above.

repeated_candidate_observations.description: S9-5C2 numerator. Observations beyond the first for their canonical candidate key. The in-run repeat rate is derived as repeated_candidate_observations / candidate_observations; no rate is stored, and it is undefined when the denominator is 0.

uncanonicalizable_candidate_observations.description: S9-5C2. Distinct source items whose target URL failed canonicalization AT THE DEDUPE BOUNDARY. Same unit as candidate_observations but EXCLUDED from it and from the three-term arithmetic: such an item never became an observation and never became a group. Not a later extraction issue - a candidate missing a title or a parseable date still becomes a candidate.

classification_decisions.description: One entry for EVERY content seen in more than one topic. Nothing is suppressed without a record here explaining why.

rounds.description: Adaptive scheduling. Round 1 is always the 12 configured cells; later rounds open bounded gap lanes only where a credible source exists. Optional: a run that never scheduled a second round omits this rather than writing an empty claim.

stop_reason.description: no_credible_source is reported, never papered over: an unmet target with no source to fill it is an honest result.

thresholds.description: The acceptance thresholds in force for this round. Recorded so it is provable they never moved: the scheduler changes WHERE it looks, never WHAT is accepted.

coverage.description: Per (topic, category). The five reporting-state counts are mutually exclusive and sum EXACTLY to applicable_full_records; cross_reference rows are excluded from all of them.

gated.description: false for case-studies and product-discovery: report-only in v1, so their states block nothing.

axis_targets.description: Target versus observed per axis value. A target is a scheduler HINT; an unmet one is reported as unmet, never met by lowering acceptance.

lane_quality.description: Per discovery lane. Reported and NEVER fed back into classification: lane membership is provenance only, and a lane's terms become evidence only when independently found in the fetched document.

request_accounting.description: Logical fetch ownership is asserted; HTTP attempts are merely observed. Three lanes sharing a feed produce ONE source-fetch owner; a 301 plus one 503 retry on that feed still produces one owner and three attempts, with the budget charged 3. Source discovery and target-page fetching are two key spaces and are counted apart: http_attempts, retries and redirect_hops are SOURCE-ONLY and always have been, and the target_ counters are their target-page counterparts. There is deliberately no combined total — summing the two would erase the boundary. The target counters are summed over one outcome per owned canonical identity, so a URL accepted in two cells or under two topics contributes once.

target_http_attempts.description: Every target HTTP attempt the run made: the first, every retry, and every request issued for a followed redirect target. Robots.txt retrieval is not a target attempt. Exact, from the per-fetch counters HttpClient froze onto each response or typed error — never estimated and never diffed from the shared client.stats.

target_retries.description: Target attempts made because of retry policy only. Following a redirect is not a retry.

target_redirect_hops.description: Redirects actually followed while fetching target pages.

merges.description: Authorized merges of two previously independent records. Only ever populated via a domain_migration rule or an alias established before the second record existed.

publication_eligible.description: false for smoke runs. `promote` refuses an ineligible run: a bounded smoke runs with enrichment disabled and deliberately produces unverified fields, so it is an infrastructure test, not publishable output.

budgets.description: Observed against configured. Present so a run that hit a cap is visible rather than silently truncated.

allOf.$comment: S9-6. Lineage is mandatory exactly where it is meaningful. A linkcheck run is DERIVED from another run and is unreadable without saying which; every other mode stands alone, so `base_run_id` stays optional there and no pre-S9-6 manifest is invalidated. Conditional rather than globally required, which is why this needs no schema_version bump.
